title: NHC blended Google DeepMind's AI ensemble into official Hurricane Melissa forecasts before its Category 5 landfall in Jamaica
summary: NHC blended Google DeepMind's AI ensemble into official Melissa forecasts from its first advisory on 21 October 2025; Cat 5 landfall in Jamaica 28 October 2025.
account: The US National Hurricane Center (NHC) blended Google DeepMind's experimental AI hurricane model (ensemble mean GDMI) into official forecasts for Tropical Storm Melissa. It did so from its first advisory, 21 October 2025. Discussion 1 placed the official track between the DeepMind ensemble mean and the consensus aid HCCA. Discussion 2 described the track as a blend of the DeepMind mean, HCCA and TVCA. Discussion 8 (23 October) moved the track toward a blend of the DeepMind mean and HCCA. Discussion 10 blended the HCCA and GDMI aids. It set an intensity forecast in best agreement with GDMI after all 50 DeepMind members showed a major hurricane. On 28 October 2025 Melissa made landfall in southwestern Jamaica near New Hope with 185 mph winds and 892 mb pressure. IFRC reported 45 deaths and about 1.6 million people affected. It relayed a World Bank/IDB estimate of US$8.8 billion in physical damage. Its CHF 80,000 Imminent DREF was approved on 23 October with a five-day lead time.
purpose: Experimental AI tropical cyclone forecast model providing ensemble track and intensity guidance to NHC forecasters.
system: Google DeepMind AI hurricane forecast model, ensemble mean designated GDMI in NHC guidance
taxonomy_note: The AI model's contribution to official forecasts is read as forecast accuracy, with no error figure for this storm.

ratings.reason: No cited source attributes an individual-level outcome to the AI guidance. Impacts are reported only at population level.
NHC's official track and intensity forecasts were materially shaped by GDMI (Discussions 8, 10, 13, 14). NHC's Science Operations Officer called the AI guidance very valuable for Melissa.

Official forecasts for a Category 5 landfall affecting about 1.6 million people. A CHF 80,000 Imminent DREF was approved on 23 October with a five-day lead time. The review says its early actions were informed by forecast risks (NHC is not named). Material to many, but no counterfactual that the AI changed outcomes.

ai_role.statement: NHC forecasters state in Discussions 8, 10, 12, 13 and 14 that official track and intensity forecasts were blended or aligned with Google DeepMind's ensemble. The official forecast remains a human synthesis of several aids. So the AI contribution to outcomes in Jamaica is not isolated.

headline: NHC blends DeepMind's ensemble into Hurricane Melissa forecasts

later.note: NHC's 2025 verification report, five months after landfall, records low official track errors for Melissa and the DeepMind ensemble mean outperforming the official Atlantic track forecast at 12 to 72 hours.
later.quote: It has been seen in multiple cases during the past few years that the NHC track errors are notably lower than average for major hurricanes, including Humberto and Melissa in 2025.
